targets.query:
SELECT * EXCEPT (rank_out, _fund_1h_min, _fund_1h_max)
FROM (
    SELECT
        coingecko_coin_id ccid,
        truncate(_fund_1h_max - _fund_1h_min, 6) diff_abs_1h,
        truncate(_fund_1h_max * 8 - _fund_1h_min * 8, 6) diff_abs_8h,
        first_value(ex) OVER w_asc AS ex_min,
        first_value(ex) OVER w_desc AS ex_max,
        first_value(ts) OVER w_asc AS ts_min,
        first_value(ts) OVER w_desc AS ts_max,
        token_1,
        first_value(funding_rate_1h) OVER w_asc AS _fund_1h_min,
        first_value(funding_rate_1h) OVER w_desc AS _fund_1h_max,
        truncate(_fund_1h_min, 6) fund_1h_min,
        truncate(_fund_1h_max, 6) fund_1h_max,
        truncate(_fund_1h_min * 8, 6) fund_8h_min,
        truncate(_fund_1h_max * 8, 6) fund_8h_max,
        row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY coingecko_coin_id) rank_out
    FROM (
        SELECT * EXCEPT (rank)
        FROM (
            SELECT
                t1.ex,
                conv_symbol_to_token_dumb(symbol) token_1,
                t1.funding_rate / t1.funding_hours funding_rate_1h,
                row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY ex, symbol ORDER BY ts DESC) AS rank,
                t2.coingecko_coin_id,
                toDateTime(t1.ts / 1000) ts
            FROM (
                SELECT *
                FROM (
                    SELECT symbol, funding_rate * 100 funding_rate, ts, ex, k, ts_write, toUInt64(t2.fundingInterval / 60) funding_hours
                    FROM default.fundings_curr_2025_01_12 t1
                    INNER JOIN (
                        SELECT *
                        FROM default.t_bybit_2025_01_02
                        WHERE k = 'fut'
                    ) t2
                        ON t1.symbol = t2.s
                    WHERE ex = 'bybit'
                )
                UNION ALL
                SELECT *
                FROM (
                    SELECT symbol, funding_rate * 100 funding_rate, ts * 1000 ts, ex, k, ts_write, funding_hours
                    FROM default.fundings_curr_2025_01_12 t1
                    INNER JOIN (
                        SELECT s, toUInt64(JSONExtract(contract_raw, 'funding_interval', 'UInt64') / 60 / 60) funding_hours
                        FROM default.t_gateio_2025_01_02
                        WHERE k = 'fut'
                    ) t2
                        ON t1.symbol = t2.s
                    WHERE ex = 'gateio'
                )
                UNION ALL
                SELECT *
                FROM (
                    SELECT symbol, funding_rate * 100 funding_rate, ts, ex, k, ts_write, 1 funding_hours
                    FROM default.fundings_curr_2025_01_12
                    WHERE ex = 'hyperliquid'
                )
                UNION ALL
                SELECT *
                FROM (
                    SELECT symbol, funding_rate * 100 funding_rate, ts * 1000 ts, ex, k, ts_write, 1 funding_hours
                    FROM default.fundings_curr_2025_01_12
                    WHERE ex = 'arkm'
                )
                UNION ALL
                SELECT *
                FROM (
                    SELECT symbol, funding_rate * 100 funding_rate, ts, ex, k, ts_write, fundingInterval funding_hours
                    FROM default.fundings_curr_2025_01_12 t1
                    INNER JOIN (
                        SELECT s, fundingInterval
                        FROM default.t_paradex_2025_01_21
                        WHERE k = 'fut'
                    ) t2
                        ON t1.symbol = t2.s
                    WHERE ex = 'paradex'
                )
                UNION ALL
                SELECT *
                FROM (
                    SELECT symbol, funding_rate / 10e17 funding_rate, ts * 1000 ts, ex, k, ts_write, 1 funding_hours
                    FROM default.fundings_curr_2025_01_12
                    WHERE ex = 'polynomial-fi'
                )
                UNION ALL
                SELECT *
                FROM (
                    SELECT symbol, funding_rate * 100 funding_rate, ts, ex, k, ts_write, 1 funding_hours
                    FROM default.fundings_curr_2025_01_12
                    WHERE ex = 'apex-pro'
                )
                UNION ALL
                SELECT *
                FROM (
                    SELECT symbol, funding_rate * 100 funding_rate, ts, ex, k, ts_write, 1 funding_hours
                    FROM default.fundings_curr_2025_01_12
                    WHERE ex = 'apex-omni'
                )
                UNION ALL
                SELECT *
                FROM (
                    SELECT symbol, funding_rate * 100 funding_rate, ts, ex, k, ts_write, 1 funding_hours
                    FROM default.fundings_curr_2025_01_12
                    WHERE ex = 'aevo'
                )
                UNION ALL
                SELECT *
                FROM (
                    SELECT symbol, funding_rate * 100 funding_rate, ts, ex, k, ts_write, 8 funding_hours
                    FROM default.fundings_curr_2025_01_12
                    WHERE ex = 'bitunix'
                )
                UNION ALL
                SELECT *
                FROM (
                    SELECT symbol, funding_rate * 100 funding_rate, ts, ex, k, ts_write, 8 funding_hours
                    FROM default.fundings_curr_2025_01_12
                    WHERE ex = 'coinex'
                )
                UNION ALL
                SELECT *
                FROM (
                    SELECT symbol, funding_rate * 100 funding_rate, ts * 1000 ts, ex, k, ts_write, 8 funding_hours
                    FROM default.fundings_curr_2025_01_12
                    WHERE ex = 'bingx'
                )
            ) t1
            INNER JOIN default.t_fut_to_coingecko_coin_id t2
                ON t1.ex = t2.ex AND token_1 = t2.base
            WHERE replaceAll(t2.coingecko_coin_id, ' ', '') != ''
                AND toDate(ts_write) = today()
                AND ts_write >= NOW() - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE
        )
        WHERE rank = 1
    )
    WINDOW w_asc AS (PARTITION BY coingecko_coin_id ORDER BY funding_rate_1h ASC),
        w_desc AS (PARTITION BY coingecko_coin_id ORDER BY funding_rate_1h DESC)
)
WHERE rank_out = 1
ORDER BY abs(diff_abs_1h) DESC
LIMIT 10

targets.formattedQuery: SELECT $timeSeries as t, count() FROM $table WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
targets.query:
SELECT
  t1.*,
  conv_symbol_to_token_dumb(t1.symbol) token_1,
  t2.coingecko_coin_id
FROM (
  SELECT ex, symbol
  FROM default.fundings_curr_2025_01_12
  GROUP BY ex, symbol
) t1
LEFT JOIN default.t_fut_to_coingecko_coin_id t2
  ON t1.ex = t2.ex AND token_1 = t2.base
WHERE t2.coingecko_coin_id = ''
ORDER BY ex, symbol
targets.rawQuery:
/* grafana dashboard=fundings, user=1 */
SELECT
  t1.*,
  conv_symbol_to_token_dumb(t1.symbol) token_1,
  t2.coingecko_coin_id
FROM (
  SELECT ex, symbol
  FROM default.fundings_curr_2025_01_12
  GROUP BY ex, symbol
) t1
LEFT JOIN default.t_fut_to_coingecko_coin_id t2
  ON t1.ex = t2.ex AND token_1 = t2.base
WHERE t2.coingecko_coin_id = ''
ORDER BY ex, symbol

targets.formattedQuery: SELECT $timeSeries as t, count() FROM $table WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
targets.query:
SELECT
  toDateTime(t1.ts / 1000) ts,
  conv_symbol_to_token_dumb(symbol) token_1,
  t1.funding_rate
FROM default.fundings_curr_2025_01_12 t1
INNER JOIN default.t_fut_to_coingecko_coin_id t2
  ON t1.ex = t2.ex AND token_1 = t2.base
WHERE replaceAll(t2.coingecko_coin_id, ' ', '') != ''
  AND ts BETWEEN toDateTime($from) AND toDateTime($to)
  AND t1.k = 'fut'
  AND t1.ex = '$var_ex'
  AND t2.coingecko_coin_id = '$var_ccid'
ORDER BY ts
targets.rawQuery:
/* grafana dashboard=fundings, user=1 */
SELECT
  toDateTime(t1.ts / 1000) ts,
  replaceRegexpOne(
    replaceRegexpOne(
      replaceRegexpOne(
        replaceRegexpOne(
          replaceRegexpOne(
            replaceRegexpOne(
              replaceRegexpOne(symbol, '-USD', '')
              , 'USDC', ''),
            '-USD-PERP', ''),
          '_PERP$', ''
        ),
      '_USDT$', ''),
    '_USDC$', ''),
    'USDT$', ''
  ) token_1,
  t1.fundingRate
FROM default.fundings_curr_2025_01_12 t1
INNER JOIN default.t_fut_to_coingecko_coin_id t2
  ON t1.ex = t2.ex AND token_1 = t2.base
WHERE replaceAll(t2.coingecko_coin_id, ' ', '') != ''
  AND ts BETWEEN toDateTime(1739150353) AND toDateTime(1739171953)
  AND t1.k = 'fut'
  AND t1.ex = 'bybit'
  AND t2.coingecko_coin_id = 'celestia'
ORDER BY ts

SELECT
    ex,
    max(ts_write) AS last_write
FROM default.fundings_curr_2025_01_12
WHERE toDate(ts_write) = today()
GROUP BY ex
ORDER BY last_write ASC

WHERE toDate(ts_write) = today()
GROUP BY ex
ORDER BY last_write AS
